_comment: Maintainer denylist for junk 'question' rows that come from the upstream upsckata.com mirror (data/questions.csv is re-syncable and never hand-edited). build.js drops any row whose source URL is in `urls` (match the full value incl. #page=N) or whose qKey() is in `keys`. Entries starting with _ are ignored. build.js also auto-drops obvious answer-body fragments (isAnswerFragment); use this file only for ones that slip past it.
_comment_mentorship: ForumIAS/Vision print these on p.30 of their sample copies as an ad for the mentorship programme — ~70 scraped 'answers' across all five papers (AUDIT B13).
_comment_essay_outlines: OCR read a topper's own plan or opening paragraph off the essay page as if it were the question ("1) What is winter? 2) …"). The real topic is indexed from other copies (UI review 2026-10-27). One such row is kept: it is the only row of Kiran Kamate's Essay copy, and dropping it would drop the copy.
